subject.title: Subagent Premature Announce Bug - Model-Specific Tool Call Handling Issues

question: Should OpenClaw ever promote provider-specific tagged tool-call markers from thinking/reasoning content into executable tool calls for Qwen/ModelStudio-style providers?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but converting reasoning text into tool execution changes a security and product boundary that automation should not choose.

options.title: Provider-scoped promotion
options.body: Allow a Qwen/ModelStudio-scoped parser that promotes only standalone tagged sections after allowed-tool validation and live provider proof.

options.title: Keep thinking non-executable
options.body: Treat thinking-embedded markers as unsupported provider output and add a clearer incomplete-turn diagnostic with model and endpoint guidance.

options.title: Shared marker parser
options.body: Add a broader shared repair parser for tagged thinking payloads, accepting a larger security and regression surface.

recommendation.title: Provider-scoped promotion
recommendation.body: Allow a Qwen/ModelStudio-scoped parser that promotes only standalone tagged sections after allowed-tool validation and live provider proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision crosses provider routing and security policy, and steipete is the strongest available routing owner from recent provider/model work and prior review context.
